source.title: WAC Leader Announcement (April 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Council Leader, Zachary Miller. He will become the new Leader of the WCA Advisory Council (WAC) and was already working as a Member of the Council.

Zachary was selected by the WCA Board, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.0%20-%20Councils.pdf) about WCA Councils.
<!-- break -->
We wish Zachary the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The Board also received an application from the following applicant:

* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar

We thank Abhijeet for applying and both applications can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/14SQZAvjrNABwBhhnHO4TMTcr6dHfWc4s).

translation.title: WCA 顾问理事会负责人任命公告（2021 年 4 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）成员 Zachary Miller 将出任理事会新负责人。

WCA 董事会依据[《WCA 理事会动议》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)第 4 节选定了 Zachary。

祝 Zachary 在新岗位上工作顺利。

董事会还收到了以下申请者的材料：

* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar

感谢 Abhijeet 提交申请。两份申请材料均可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/14SQZAvjrNABwBhhnHO4TMTcr6dHfWc4s)查看。
